name: stormdesk-ghl
description: StormDesk: Grok Bot skills + HighLevel MCP for home-service companies (roofing, fencing, turf, restoration). Storm-surge intake, triage, estimates, claims, permits, follow-up — and day-to-day ops after the storm.

GHL_PIT.title: HighLevel Private Integration Token
GHL_PIT.description: Sub-account Private Integration Token (Settings → Private Integrations). Scopes: contacts, conversations, conversation messages, opportunities, calendars, calendar events, custom fields, forms, locations, payments (read).

GHL_LOCATION_ID.title: HighLevel Location (sub-account) ID
GHL_LOCATION_ID.description: The sub-account this plugin install is bound to. One install per contractor sub-account.
